steps.en: Install the desktop app, or run the shared server with Docker Compose
steps.zh: 装桌面应用，或用 Docker Compose 起共享服务

component.zh: 桌面应用或 coral 服务

steps.en: In the Coral UI, add a provider from the catalog, an OpenAPI document or an MCP server
steps.zh: 在 Coral 界面添加 provider（目录、OpenAPI 或 MCP）

steps.en: Give the provider's tools a default policy: reads run, everything else waits for approval
steps.zh: 给新 provider 的工具配默认策略：只读直接跑，其余要审批

steps.en: Add the workspace MCP URL to your agent
steps.zh: 把工作区的 MCP 地址加进你的 agent
steps.code: claude mcp add --scope user --transport http coral <your-mcp-url>

steps.en: Ask a question; your agent sends a short TypeScript program through the exec tool
steps.zh: 提一个问题；agent 经 exec 工具发来一段 TypeScript 程序

steps.en: Run it in a fresh V8 isolate, check each provider call, add credentials and forward it
steps.zh: 在全新 V8 isolate 里运行，逐次查策略、补凭据再转发

steps.en: Approve the exact call in the Coral UI when its policy is Ask
steps.zh: 策略为 Ask 时，在 Coral 界面批准这一次具体调用

steps.en: Return only the program's result; a working program can be saved and called again as a custom tool
steps.zh: 只回传程序结果；跑通的程序可存成自定义工具再调

value.en: Your agent acts on real systems with per-call Allow/Ask/Block, never holds the credentials, and reuses what worked
value.zh: agent 能动真实系统，每次调用受允许／询问／阻止约束，不经手凭据，跑通的能复用
